newsitem.title: UK: UK clears Triplex Lloyd bid for Wm Cook.
newsitem.headline: UK clears Triplex Lloyd bid for Wm Cook.

text.p: Britain on Thursday cleared engineering group Triplex Lloyd in its hostile bid for William Cook by not referring it for investigation with the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
Triplex has made a bid based on seven of its own shares and 1350 pence in cash for every nine William Cook shares making it worth 309 pence a share since its launch in mid-November.

City analysts expect Triplex to raise the bid to about 400 pence per share with Triplex getting valid acceptances in respect of only 73,883 sahres representing 0.39 percent of William Cook's issued ordinary share capital.
Triplex has extended the cash and share offer for the metal castings specialist until 1500 GMT on February 4, 1997.
